notes: Next keeps the genre. When a song ends or you tap next, the app takes the next song in the same genre from your list, and the card shows what is up next before it happens. When nothing else in that genre is in the list, the same place offers more of the genre in one tap.
The genre row keeps its place. Swipe along it, tap a genre, and the row stays where you left it instead of snapping back to the first tile every time the page redraws.
Twelve more genres on the rail, including Amapiano, Reggaeton, Bollywood, Trap, Lo-fi, Soul, Funk, Metal, Blues, Disco, House and Workout.
